_instructions: Policy context for the NYC Rent Burden Atlas. Add only entries you have verified against an official source (statute text, agency page, official program documentation). An entry is displayed ONLY when it has both 'source_url' and 'verified_on'. Leave 'items' empty until then: the site shows a placeholder instead. Do not paraphrase eligibility rules, funding amounts or legal effects you have not checked.

item_template.name: Official name of the law, bill, program or grant
item_template.type: law | bill | program | grant | tax incentive | regulation
item_template.status: e.g. enacted, proposed, active, expired — as stated by the source
item_template.summary: One or two neutral sentences, based on the cited source
item_template.relevance: Which part of this analysis it relates to: rent burden, affordable housing production (new construction / preservation), income, specific boroughs
item_template.source_name: Publisher of the source (e.g. agency or legislature)

categories.title: Federal housing programs
categories.description: Federal programs that fund, subsidise or regulate affordable rental housing or rental assistance.

categories.title: New York State legislation and programs
categories.description: State laws, bills and programs affecting rents, tenant protections or affordable housing supply.

categories.title: New York City policies and programs
categories.description: City plans, agency programs and regulations, including those reflected in the HPD production data.
